_why: Per-chunk gzipped budgets, checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs after a build. Lighthouse audits pages and cannot reach a route behind Keycloak, which is every route in this application except /login; this reaches every chunk. Numbers are what each chunk measured when the budget was added, plus 2% rounded up - enough that an ordinary edit does not fail the build, not enough to absorb a new dependency. Never raise one to make a build pass.

_notes.exceljs.min.js: MUI X Premium's Excel export, a direct dependency of @mui/x-data-grid-premium. Lazy - nobody fetches it unless they export - but it is 23% of everything this application ships. It leaves entirely on DataGridPro, which is worth measuring against what Premium features the grids actually use.
_notes.rasterizeHTML.js: Pulled in by the grid's print export. Not obviously load-bearing - worth checking whether print is reachable at all.
_notes.totalBytes: 1199 KB measured on MUI 9.4.0 / MUI X 9.13.0, after lodash left: a 25,990-byte gzipped drop for five call sites, and the budget is RATCHETED DOWN to match rather than left with the slack in it. The previous baseline was 1211 KB on 9.3.1 / 9.12.0 - the bump cost 5 KB gzipped, and these numbers were re-derived as part of it rather than raised later under pressure. symposia-ui holds 900 KB, which is the number to aim at rather than to declare: this app ships MUI X Premium's grid, charts and pickers where Symposia ships one grid.
_notes.application.js: Grew 4.2 KB gzipped for the display preferences: the store, the theme provider, the settings controls and the typeface registry. A deliberate addition, re-derived here rather than raised later under pressure.
_notes.useThemeStore.css: The application's stylesheet, INCLUDING the @font-face rules for all five typefaces - which cost 317 bytes gzipped between them, because a variable font's @font-face is small and the 892 KB of woff2 beside it is only fetched when a family is actually painted. The name is rolldown's, derived from whichever module anchors the chunk; it changed from application.css when the entry graph did. A rename shows up here as one chunk unbudgeted and another no longer built, which is noisy but not wrong.
_notes.i18n.js: The translation catalogue, which this branch's Insights strings pushed past the 15000 split threshold into a chunk of its own. It was inside application.js on main, and application.js is 497 bytes smaller here, so the initial load did not grow - the catalogue simply became a parallel request.
